price_note: Each url is the shop page for that exact part, checked reachable on 2026-10-24, with shop_price in shop_currency for shop_pack_qty pieces. unit_price_eur is the price per piece in euros at the ECB reference rates of 2026-10-23 (1 EUR = 1.1193 USD = 0.83728 GBP = 1.5665 CAD). Prices move and shipping is extra; check before ordering. The build is the reference micro from Mediocre Nerd, Build a Micro FPV Drone for $59 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4nRgEmdwtJo).

parts.name: 1103 15000KV (no-name)
parts.note: The no-name motor from the video, the same AliExpress listing: 4 x 1103 15000KV 1S-2S for 32.19 EUR (8.05 EUR each). 3.7 g is BetaFPV's figure for its 1103 15000KV; 50 g is a vendor's 1S full-throttle thrust on a Gemfan 1635-4 (40 mm). No efficiency is published; 2.0 g/W is an estimate for this class.

parts.name: Gemfan 2020 51 mm 4-blade
parts.note: 0.93 g and 4 blades on a 1.5 mm shaft per BetaFPV; 2.50 USD per set of four (two CW, two CCW), in stock in Transparent Black. The pitch is listed as 1.9 or 2.0 inch depending on the shop.

parts.name: Tattu FunFly 4S 1300mAh 100C
parts.note: 149.5 g and 73 x 35 x 28.5 mm per Tattu (SKU TAA13004S10X6), 19.59 USD at Tattu's own shop.

parts.name: Tattu R-Line 1S 550mAh 95C
parts.note: The video's 1S 550 pack. Tattu's own shop sells its 1S 550 mAh as a 75C HV pack with BT2.0, 15 g and 66 x 15.5 x 7.5 mm, 29.99 USD for five; the R-Line 1S stops at 500 mAh (14 g, 58 x 18 x 8 mm). The mass is Tattu's 15 g; the size stays the 500 mAh R-Line's.

parts.name: BetaFPV LAVA II 1S 680mAh 95C
parts.note: 16.2 g, 80 x 15 x 6.5 mm, 3.8 V LiHV, 95C, BT2.0 per BetaFPV. Variant 680mAh (4PCS) at 24.99 USD; unit_price_eur is a quarter of that.

parts.name: BetaFPV Matrix 1S 5IN1 V2 AIO
parts.note: BetaFPV now calls it Matrix 1S Brushless Flight Controller (5IN1 II); shops say 5IN1 V2. 4.1 g solder-free, 26 x 26 mm mount, 1S, 12 A ESCs, ELRS receiver and a 400 mW video transmitter, 54.99 USD in stock. The video uses it because the MEPS AIO 7A is sold out.

parts.name: Twiglet 2" carbon toothpick frame
parts.note: 5.3 g with a 26 x 26 mm stack mount per Unmanned Tech's Twiglet 2 listing, 7.03 GBP, sold out on 2026-10-24. cad_frame models it in FreeCAD and replaces the mass with the carbon volume.

parts.name: Caddx Ant 1200TVL nano camera
parts.note: 2 g, 14 x 14 mm, 1200TVL, 1.8 mm lens; 17.90 USD at Caddx's own shop, in stock in 4:3 and 16:9.

parts.name: Toothpick canopy and battery holder (TPU)
parts.note: The video's AliExpress canopy listing is gone, so this is DaveC's Gatehunter TPU canopy for 14 mm cameras on whoop board spacing, 5.80 CAD, 2.6 g published. The 3D model is DLQFPV's printable toothpick canopy for the same camera (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); 2 g with the battery holder is an estimate.

parts.name: M1.4 x 3 mm motor bolts
parts.note: Black Phillips pan-head screws, M1.2 to M4, 50 per bag, 1.25 EUR for the listed size (0.03 EUR each, rounded up to the cent); pick M1.4 x 3 mm so they stop short of the windings, as the video says. Mass per bolt is an estimate.
